title.en: Europe brings AI’s builders and pioneers into one strategic discussion
title.zh: 欧洲把AI建设者与先驱请入同一场战略讨论

summary.en: EU leaders discuss investment, capability, adoption and trust with Arthur Mensch and Geoffrey Hinton; implementation and outcomes remain ahead.
summary.zh: 欧盟领导人与Arthur Mensch、Geoffrey Hinton讨论投资、能力、应用与信任；落实和成效仍待检验。

title.en: The mangroves are returning. What made room for them?
title.zh: 红树林正在回来：是什么为它们腾出了空间？

summary.en: NASA revisits a satellite-recorded rebound, with natural expansion and regrowth alongside regional losses and young forests’ limits.
summary.zh: NASA重访卫星记录中的红树林恢复：自然扩张与再生带来可能，区域损失和幼林功能仍需正视。
